query:
SELECT s.id AS source_id, ss.id AS snapshot_id
            FROM sources s
            JOIN source_snapshots ss ON ss.source_id = s.id
            WHERE (s.track_id = $1 OR s.album_id = $1 OR s.artist_id = $1)
              AND s.platform = $2 AND s.external_id IS NULL
              AND ss.data = $3
            ORDER BY ss.id
            LIMIT 1
